about.title: About
about.p1: I have been a full-stack developer at Sunsoft-Sunrise since 2020. I build the company's applications and deploy them to production on Linux servers, including projects for PSI Madagascar in the pharmacy sector.
about.p2: In 2024 I founded Xonobox, my independent studio. I deliver web and mobile apps to clients directly: a health mutual, a ride-hailing platform.
about.p3: My daily stack is Vue.js, NestJS and Flutter. I care about maintainable code: Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, unit tests.

projects.title: Case studies
projects.intro: Real client projects. The code and data belong to the clients, so the illustrations use fictional data.
projects.caption: Illustration: fictional interface and data.
projects.captionConfidential: Illustration with fictional data. The real code and data are confidential.

efameno.problem: The mutual needed to enroll members and handle reimbursements in rural areas where the network is weak.
efameno.built: An Android app for field agents that works offline on tablets and syncs over the internet when the network is back, and a web admin app for the mutual.
efameno.status: Direct contract with Harena mutual: sprint 2 in progress, sprint 3 requested by the client.
efameno.alt: The offline enrollment form on a field agent's tablet, and the mutual's collections and reimbursements dashboard (interface in French).
efameno.phase2: Phase 2: the mutual chose to continue with Xonobox directly, with no intermediary

s2.name: Sprint 2
s2.text: Healthcare providers, collections and reimbursement dashboard

efameno.phase1Done: Delivered: digital member enrollment and payment reimbursement, with an Android app for field agents and a web admin app.

carheav.problem: A local client needed a complete ride-hailing platform.
carheav.built: A rider app, a driver app and a web back office to manage rides, users and vehicles.
carheav.role: Built at Xonobox: Flutter mobile apps, Vue.js back office, NestJS REST API.
carheav.status: Demo approved by the client, production launch in preparation.
carheav.alt: A rider app showing a route on a map, a driver app with a ride request, and a back office listing rides, users and vehicles (interface in French).

pharmaplus.problem: Medicine depots needed to track their sales and stock.
pharmaplus.built: An Android mobile app and a web app for sales and inventory management.
pharmaplus.role: Development and maintenance of both apps.
pharmaplus.status: Company project. Code and data are confidential.
pharmaplus.alt: A depot stock table with low-stock and expiry alerts, and a quick-sale cart on a phone (interface in French).

datapharm.problem: Pharmacies across Madagascar needed one place to manage their medicines.
datapharm.built: A web application that centralizes medicine management for pharmacies.
datapharm.status: Company project. Code and data are confidential.
datapharm.alt: Pharmacies connected to a central medicine reference.

xonobox.text: Web and mobile apps for direct clients: e-famenoPlus for Harena health mutual, the Carheav ride-hailing platform.

sunsoft.text: Full-stack development and production deployment of the company's applications on a Linux VPS. Projects delivered for PSI Madagascar: PharmaPlusLite and DataPharm.
